findings.finding: An open at-the-market program of up to $9.82m through Ladenburg Thalmann (424B5 dated 2026-09-24) is larger than the company's entire equity value at the $3.645 screen price (~1.95m+ shares, ~$7m), so the issuer can sell into any rebound on 2026-10-05 with no further notice.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An effective, already-supplemented ATM has no pricing event: draws can occur on any session including 2026-10-05, and the issuer has drawn shelf/ATM capacity repeatedly (424B5s 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-24; outstanding share count roughly quadrupled 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-25).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the ATM supplement and the 2026-09-23 -74% day, the name's next-close moves after falls were -20.8, +9.1, -11.6, -15.4, -12.2, -7.7 (baseline history), i.e. four of six continued by more than 7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices today's supply, not tomorrow's: an ATM larger than the market cap means the cap on rebounds is structural; if the price held it, today's 5% gap-up would not have reversed 12% intraday and the cross-section prior (+0.5% for this fall size) would not be the relevant bar.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-29 PRER14A asks shareholders to cut the ELOC floor price and authorise another reverse split of up to 1-for-150, i.e. the company itself plans further equity issuance below current levels: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1585608/000119312526407517/d78419dprer14a.htm

findings.finding: Streeterville Capital received 729,989 shares on 2026-09-23 and 481,584 on 2026-09-25 in Section 3(a)(9) debt exchanges at effective prices of ~$9.21 and ~$7.07, about 1.21m freely tradable shares against ~1.95m outstanding, and the 2021 Note was not fully cancelled so further exchanges remain possible.
findings.mechanism_in_window: 3(a)(9) exchange shares tack the original notes' holding period and are saleable immediately; at $3.645 the holder is underwater on each exchange and its sales continue through 2026-10-05; a further exchange would be disclosed by 8-K on the four-business-day clock the last two followed (2026-09-24, 2026-09-28).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-09-24 and 2026-09-28 exchange 8-Ks the stock's following-session moves were +9.1 (09-25, off a -20.8 day) and -11.6/-15.4/-12.2 (09-29 to 10-01), from the baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: Volume today (~$1.9m, ~0.5m shares) is a fraction of the 1.21m exchange shares, so the holder's inventory is unlikely to be spent; if it were, the late-session tape would show support rather than a reversal of the opening gap. This is an inference about an undisclosed holder's selling, so it is sized smaller than the ATM.
